description: Fetch a DEV.to organization's public profile by username. Uses the public Forem API first; if the API returns a rate-limit or critical failure, falls back to extracting the profile from the DEV.to organization page. Optionally include member list with --include_members true.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Organization username, the profile URL path segment (https://dev.to/<org>). Case-insensitive; normalized to lowercase.

parameters.name: include_members
parameters.description: Also fetch the organization's member list (true | false, default false). In browser fallback mode only the first 50 visible members are returned.
